away.summary: The Blue Jackets (5-5-0) are projected to start Jet Greaves in net against Carolina. The lineup includes Matthew Knies, who is set to reach 250 career games, and features a forward group led by Valeri Nichushkin, Adam Fantilli, and Kent Johnson. Ivan Provorov and Isac Lundestrom are out with lower-body injuries.

out.detail: upper body injury; will miss his seventh straight game

home.summary: The Hurricanes (10-2-2) are projected to start Pyotr Kochetkov, who is off to a 7-0-0 start with a 1.70 GAA and .916 save percentage. Taylor Hall remains out with an upper-body injury after leaving morning skate early Tuesday, while Jordan Staal is sidelined with a calf injury. Alexander Nikishin has signed a one-year contract but is not yet in the projected lineup.
